Method of Attack: Exploited zero-day vulnerability in Salesforce's email services and SMTP servers to launch phishing campaign
Bypassed Salesforce's sender verification safeguards using Email-to-Case feature exploitation
Used Salesforce-generated email addresses to send phishing emails bypassing email filters and anti-phishing systems
Phishing emails led to Facebook gaming platform phishing pages to steal Facebook account credentials with 2FA bypass
Discoverer: Guardio Labs analysts Oleg Zaytsev and Nati Tal
Attack Vector: Exploitation of Salesforce Email-to-Case feature to create verified Salesforce email addresses
Mass sending phishing emails from Salesforce domain
Phishing landing pages hosted on Facebook gaming platform
